messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the statutory holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1 – 3** |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, ON) | Friday Feb 17 | – | **Feb 17 – 19** |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7 – 9** |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | – | **May 22 – 24** |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Friday Jul 1 | **Jul 1 – 3** |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 4 – 6** |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 9 – 11** |
| Christmas | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 25 – 27** |

> **Note:**  
> • Some holidays (e.g., Family Day) are province‑specific; the dates above apply to the provinces that observe it.  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekend, the statutory “observed” day is usually the following Monday (or the preceding Friday for Canada Day).  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
